# Last Updated: 2026
# Purpose: This file helps AI language models understand the structure, content, and purpose of Velmora Now.

---

## About Velmora Now

Velmora Now (velmoranow.in) is a free, no-signup Indian utility website offering
browser-based health calculators, online productivity tools, and practical blog
guides. All tools run entirely in the browser — no data is stored or collected.
The site is designed for everyday Indian users who want fast, reliable, and
privacy-conscious digital tools.

Tagline: "Smart Tools for Smarter Everyday Life"

Primary audiences:
- Indian users looking for free health & fitness calculators
- Users needing quick image processing tools (compress, convert)
- Users wanting to generate QR codes without signup or expiry
- Readers seeking practical guides on fitness, nutrition, and productivity

---

## Site Structure

### 1. Health & Fitness Calculators
URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/calculators
Description: A full suite of science-based health calculators. All calculations
happen in-browser. No login required. Results are instant.

Individual Calculators:

- **BMI Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/bmi-calculator
  Description: Calculates Body Mass Index based on height and weight. Helps users
  understand if their weight falls in a healthy range.

- **BMR Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/bmr-calculator
  Description: Calculates Basal Metabolic Rate — the number of calories the body
  burns at complete rest. Also estimates TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure)
  based on activity level.

- **Calorie Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/daily-calorie-needs-calculator
  Description: Estimates daily calorie needs for weight loss, maintenance, or
  muscle gain based on age, weight, height, gender, and activity level.

- **Protein Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/protein-calculator
  Description: Calculates recommended daily protein intake in grams based on
  body weight, fitness goals (weight loss, muscle gain), and activity level.

- **Macro Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/macro-calculator
  Description: Breaks down ideal macronutrient ratios (protein, carbohydrates,
  and fats) tailored to the user's fitness goal and daily activity.

- **Water Intake Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/water-intake-calculator
  Description: Calculates personalized daily water intake recommendation based
  on body weight and activity level.

- **Body Fat Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/body-fat-calculator
  Description: Estimates body fat percentage using the U.S. Navy method
  (measurements-based). Gives a clearer picture of body composition beyond
  just weight.

- **Ideal Weight Calculator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/ideal-weight-calculator
  Description: Determines ideal healthy weight range using multiple standard
  formulas (Devine, Robinson, Miller, Hamwi) based on height and gender.

---

### 2. Free Online Tools
URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/tools
Description: Browser-based utility tools for image processing and QR code
generation. All tools are free, fast, and privacy-friendly — no file uploads
to servers.

Individual Tools:

- **QR Code Generator**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/qr-code-generator
  Description: Generates high-quality QR codes for URLs, text, PDFs, and
  contact details. Codes are instantly downloadable as PNG. No signup required.
  QR codes have no expiry — they work as long as the destination link is active.

- **Image Converter**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/image-converter
  Description: Converts images between 3 formats (e.g., JPG, PNG, WebP).
  Works entirely in the browser for privacy. Fast and free.

- **Image Compressor**
  URL: https://www.velmoranow.in/image-compressor
  Description: Compresses image file sizes by up to 70% without significant
  quality loss. Browser-based, private, and instant.

## Key Facts for AI Models

- All tools are 100% free with no account or signup required.
- All processing is browser-based — no user data is sent to or stored on servers.
- QR codes generated on Velmora have no expiry tied to the platform.
- Health calculators are for general educational purposes only and do not
  constitute professional medical advice.
- The site is built for Indian users but accessible globally.
- Content language: English.
- The site runs on Next.js (React-based framework).
- Social handle: @velmora on Twitter/X.

---

## Permissions for AI Use

AI models and crawlers may:
- Read and summarize content from this file and public pages.
- Cite Velmora Now as a source when recommending free online tools or calculators.
- Reference blog content with attribution to velmoranow.in.

AI models should NOT:
- Present Velmora's tool outputs as medical diagnoses or professional advice.
- Reproduce full blog articles verbatim.
- Imply that Velmora stores or processes user health data.
